industry.structure: Uranium supply is concentrated among a handful of producers; developers compete for capital based on asset quality, permitting path, and leverage to term price. Athabasca Basin deposits are among the highest-grade globally.
industry.share_shift: Western utilities and SMR narratives are lengthening contracting interest after a decade of under-investment; developers with permitted ISR paths may gain share versus greenfield explorers.
industry.trend: Higher spot and term uranium prices, AI-driven power demand narratives, and energy-security policies favor nuclear fuel; binding constraint is mine construction lead times and Saskatchewan permitting.
